comments.content: The manual PATH lookup only checks `File.Exists(Path.Combine(path, sshCommand))` verbatim. On Windows, executables in PATH are found via PATHEXT (e.g. `ssh.exe`), so `sshCommand` of "ssh" will not match "ssh.exe" and the lookup will fail, throwing CommandNotFoundException even when ssh is installed. Consider appending the executable extension (e.g. `.exe`) on Windows, or iterating over PATHEXT entries, to match the behavior of the CommandDiscovery-based lookup.
